source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
A random characteristic is rolled when it is needed:

- **M**: when the unit is **selected to move**, roll the dice shown once for the whole unit’s move.
- **A**: roll for each weapon separately as its attacks are generated in the [Resolve Attacks](vsdata:core-rule/resolve-attacks) step, then group any **identical attacks** together.
- **D**: each time an attack with the weapon inflicts damage, its controlling player rolls once the opposing player has picked the target unit’s model to allocate it to; that roll is a **damage roll**.
- A value after an operator in **D**, as the +1 in D6+1, belongs to D and is not a modifier.
- Any other characteristic: roll for each model or weapon each time it is needed.
